text:
[title] What to remember
[body] Serve more users on the same GPUs
[body] No change to what the model says
[body] Open-sourced this quarter

novice.takeaway: The presenter is summarizing that their method lets more users be served on the same hardware without changing model output, and will be released as open source this quarter.
questions: When exactly this quarter will it be released?
Which specific model or system is being open-sourced?
novice.inferred_claim: The presenter wants viewers to remember the efficiency gain, unchanged accuracy, and upcoming open-source release.

peer.takeaway: The presenter is summarizing that their system increases user capacity per GPU without altering model output, and will be open-sourced soon.
questions: What is the open-source release timeline exactly?
Which repository or license will be used?
peer.inferred_claim: The audience should expect and adopt this open-sourced efficiency system this quarter.

expert.takeaway: The presenter is summarizing the key claims: higher throughput per GPU without changing model outputs, and a commitment to open-source the work this quarter.
questions: What specifically will be open-sourced—code, weights, or benchmarks?
Which framework or repo will host the release?
expert.inferred_claim: The presenter wants the audience to remember the efficiency gains are lossless and will soon be publicly available.
